items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: he used to dog my footsteps, no matter where I was. Copped all my licks. Got on Buddy’s band playing all my licks.

ctx.x: Yeah. He offered it to me I think three times and I turned him down three times because I was doing other stuff. But a guy who used to follow me around all the time, his name was Jay Craig, a Scottish baritone player who had gone to Berklee, and he used to dog my footsteps, no matter where I was. Copped all my licks. Got on Buddy’s band playing all my licks.

Do you know that there’s a little — now that you’re at Fredonia — there’s a little Fredonia story with Buddy. He came to play a concert, and this would have been probably ’72. And his piano player was either ill or whatever, they had no piano player that night. And Onaje Allen Gumbs —
